fieldValues.title: μDemocracy Mapping is not childless — it still contains a table record with real content
fieldValues.summary: Correcting finding-51845c8c: of the four empty-outline design-notes named in srs#636, three (Design Decisions, Usage Guidance, Extension Design Notes) genuinely carried no relation but the inbound `contains` edge from their concept and were deleted. The fourth, μDemocracy Mapping, has an empty `content` field but is not childless — it holds an outbound `contains` edge to a `table` record (b1000000-0000-4000-a000-000000000005) carrying the live SCDS-to-μDemocracy vocabulary mapping, extracted from the note by scripts/migrate-tables.mjs when tables were split out of prose. Left in place per the issue own instruction ("if any turns out to carry content, leave it and say so"); srs#636 deleted the other three only.
evidence: `srs relation list --repo srs` shows Design Decisions, Usage Guidance and Extension Design Notes each with exactly one relation (the inbound `contains` edge), and μDemocracy Mapping with two: the same inbound edge plus an outbound `contains` edge to table b1000000-0000-4000-a000-000000000005

The target table record's `intro` field reads verbatim: "How the SCDS v2 vocabulary mapping to the μDemocracy application layer. Reproduced from the v1→v2 conceptual remapping document for reference." — live content, not scaffolding

scripts/migrate-tables.mjs (merged pre-programme, PR #544) shows the table was extracted out of design-note f1000041 and the design-note's own `content` field was blanked as part of that extraction, which is why it now reads as empty outline scaffolding despite still carrying real content one hop down
fieldValues.body: The class of finding "empty content field, homed only to keep the tree total" needs one more check before it licenses deletion: whether the record has an outbound `contains` edge of its own. finding-51845c8c generalised from all four notes sharing an empty `content` field to all four being safe to delete; the generalisation held for three of four. The instruction in srs#636 itself ("If any turns out to carry content, leave it and say so") anticipated exactly this and is why the discrepancy was caught at Ground rather than causing a live table to be silently orphaned.
